summary_ja: コモディティについてマチュリティ・ラダーを用い、期間帯内のスポット価格およびスプレッド・レート、繰越しポジション、残存ネット・ポジションの賦課率により算出する方法を定める。
summary_en: Prescribes the maturity ladder method for commodities: spot-price and spread-rate charges within time bands, a 0.6% charge on carried-forward positions and 15% on residual net positions.
paragraphs: The method of calculating the market risk equivalent amount of the commodity risk category by the maturity ladder method shall be the total of the amounts calculated as prescribed below. In this case, after converting the net position in each commodity, etc. into the domestic currency at the spot price as of the calculation reference date, a maturity ladder consisting of the seven time bands set forth in the table in item (i) shall be prepared for each commodity, etc., and the amount of the long position and the amount of the short position of that commodity, etc. shall be entered into the maturity ladder; provided, however, that where there is physical inventory, it shall be entered into the time band of one month or less, and in markets with daily delivery dates, the amounts of long positions and short positions falling due within ten days may be treated as the amount of offsetting positions: (i) The amount obtained by multiplying the total of the amount of the long position and the amount of the short position of each commodity, etc. that are offsetting within each time band by the spot price (meaning the price formed in a transaction in which a commodity (excluding gold) is delivered within two business days from the date of conclusion of the sale or purchase) and by the spread rate prescribed in the following table shall be calculated. {{T:p411t0}}; (ii) For the amount of the long position or the short position of each commodity, etc. that is not offsetting within each time band referred to in the preceding item, the amount obtained by multiplying the amount of that position by 0.6% shall be calculated. In this case, that position shall be carried forward from the adjacent time band to a time band in which there is a position (provided that the time band of more than three years shall be the upper limit); (iii) The amount of the position carried forward under the preceding item shall be the amount obtained by multiplying by the spread rate prescribed in the table in item (i) the sum of that amount and the amount of the long position or the short position of each commodity, etc. that is offsetting within each time band; (iv) For the net position of each commodity, etc. remaining in a time band in the calculations under the preceding three items, the amount shall be the amount obtained by multiplying that net position by 15%.
